newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen firm on foreign interest.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen firm on foreign interest.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were seen buoyant on Monday on foreign interest in blue-chip stocks, brokers said.

"There is foreign buying interest for blue chip stocks. Retailers and high network local investors are also looking to buy and sell. Its an ideal trading market," said Ajit Dias Wanigasekera of Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
Brokers said interest was ripe for fundamentally strong stocks such as the banking, food and beverage and manufacturing sectors.
"But still there will be some profit taking. People who brought during the last rally are thinking of selling," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.
On Friday, the Colombo all share index closed 9.0 points up at 819.7 on turnover of 84.6 million rupees.
The Kahawatte Plantations deal, in which the government is selling 51 percent or 10.2 million shares at a minimum of 30 rupees each, is due to be concluded today.
Two more similar deals are due to take place this week.
